target_customer: Telehealth, wellness and digital health brands and health systems that want to offer lab-analyzed at-home tests
problem: Brands wanting to sell at-home diagnostics must assemble kits, logistics, physician authorization and lab integrations themselves.
business_model: B2B usage-based API, per test kit

founders.name: Andrew Jajack
founders.background_notes: YC page gives no background. An aggregator profile (not opened) calls him a PhD in biomedical engineering and a second-time YC founder; unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: An API layer over kit fulfillment, lab integrations and physician authorization is standard engineering plus regulatory and operations work (the site says it is HIPAA compliant and handles state doctor-order rules).

defensibility.rationale: Lab and logistics integrations take time but the model could be copied by larger testing firms; no sourced evidence of exclusive lab contracts.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Third-party profiles say LetsGetChecked offers white-label kits and an API, but these pages are undated, so no dated incumbent response is recorded.

market_need_then: Growth of telehealth and direct-to-consumer health brands in 2021 created demand for at-home testing, per the company's own positioning. No dated spend figures found.

identity.logo: Simple wordmark with orange circle accents (site description)
identity.visual_style: Clean modern light background with orange accents

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand found; the site is clean but generic and sells a white-label product that hides the Spot name from end users.

outcome_analysis: Spot appears to be a small active B2B diagnostics infrastructure company that sells white-label at-home test kits through an API. Public sources show no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs, and a job listing claims tens of thousands of kits shipped, though undated. Funding is unclear, with aggregators showing about 600 thousand dollars in total, so the outcome is still open.
notes: Aggregators disagree on funding: PitchBook snippet shows 608K total with a 108K accelerator entry dated 2022-02, CB Insights snippet shows 600K seed. Seen only in aggregator snippets, so unverified and not recorded as rounds. No dated competitor sources found, so the list is empty. Search for outcome found no news.
